title: Authentication & Authorization
description: Implement OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and RBAC in .NET applications.

data.text: Authentication verifies identity, authorization grants access. Use OAuth2 for delegated access and OpenID Connect for identity.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Authentication and authorization are foundational to security. Use OAuth2/OIDC for modern auth and RBAC for fine-grained access control.
